quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #17
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: What will help a person who has consumed alcohol?

options.text: Tomato juice and lime
Hot coffee
Fresh air
Only time

questions.correctAnswerText: Only time
questions.explanation: Only time will allow alcohol to leave a person's body.

questions.question: Which statement is true about road work zones?

options.text: Fines for violations in work zones are the same as in normal traffic.
You must slow down for the cone zone.
Slow down only if you see workers present.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must slow down for the cone zone.
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed in work zones. Driving carefully through work zones keeps drivers, pedestrians, cyclists, and workers safe.

questions.question: Alcohol in any amount is:

options.text: A stimulant.
A depressant.
Neither of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: A depressant.
questions.explanation: Alcohol is a depressant. It slows down nerve impulses and body functions. It reduces inhibitions and harms your ability to concentrate and stay alert.

questions.question: Where should you keep a space cushion around your vehicle?

options.text: Only behind your vehicle.
Only on the left and right sides of your vehicle.
Only in front of your vehicle.
On all sides of your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: On all sides of your vehicle.
questions.explanation: Keep space around all sides of your vehicle. This gives you time to react to hazards. Do not crowd vehicles beside you.

questions.question: To turn left from a multi-lane one-way street onto another one-way street, start from:

options.text: Any lane (as long as it is safe).
The lane closest to the left curb.
The center lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to the left curb.
questions.explanation: When turning left from a one-way street onto another one-way street, start from the far left lane.

questions.question: If a train is close enough or fast enough to be a danger, you must:

options.text: Slow down and proceed carefully.
Wait until the train has completely passed before crossing.
Cross the tracks at your own risk.
Find another route across the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the train has completely passed before crossing.
questions.explanation: Look and listen for trains before crossing railroad tracks. Do not cross if a train is near or moving fast. This applies even if there are no signals or signals are broken.

questions.question: What does a yellow left turn arrow mean?

options.text: Get ready to yield to oncoming traffic.
The protected left turn is ending.
Both of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both of the above.
questions.explanation: A yellow left arrow means the protected turn is ending. You must prepare to yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No U-turn.
Two-way left turn.
Minimum speed limit.
No parking.

questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: Two solid white lines across a traffic lane show a crosswalk. As a driver, you should know:

options.text: Vehicles have the right-of-way over pedestrians in crosswalks.
Give pedestrians in crosswalks the right-of-way.
No one has the right-of-way in a crosswalk.
Pedestrians must stay out of the way of traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give pedestrians in crosswalks the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: Crosswalk lines show where pedestrians can safely cross. You must always stop for pedestrians in a crosswalk.

questions.question: A driver entering a highway from an entrance or acceleration ramp should:

options.text: Yield to drivers already on the highway.
Has the right-of-way.
Force their way into traffic.
Assume other drivers will change lanes for you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to drivers already on the highway.
questions.explanation: When entering a highway from an entrance or acceleration ramp, yield to drivers already on the highway. Merge safely when you can.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Highway entrance ramp.
Road widens.
Right lane ends.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending. Drivers should be ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed limit.
The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
You must not travel below the speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum speed allowed. You can drive slower based on conditions, but you cannot drive faster than this speed limit.

questions.question: A broken yellow line beside a solid yellow line indicates that:

options.text: Passing is permitted from the lane next to the solid yellow line.
Passing is not permitted from either direction.
Passing is permitted from the lane next to the broken yellow line.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is permitted from the lane next to the broken yellow line.
questions.explanation: The broken yellow line means passing is allowed from that side. The solid yellow line means passing is not allowed from that side.

questions.question: Excessive speed:

options.text: Does not increase the chance of a crash.
Increases your ability to react to a hazard.
Often leads to high-risk decision-making.

questions.correctAnswerText: Often leads to high-risk decision-making.
questions.explanation: Excessive speed is a major cause of crashes. It does not save time and leads to poor driving decisions.

questions.question: You are merging onto an interstate highway. You should:

options.text: Select a safe gap and merge into the lane of traffic.
Merge across two lanes at once.
Always stop before entering the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Select a safe gap and merge into the lane of traffic.
questions.explanation: Find a safe gap in traffic and merge smoothly into it. Do not stop on the entrance ramp unless you cannot find a safe gap.

questions.question: When may you proceed through an intersection that has a stop sign but no stop line or crosswalk?

options.text: After slowing down to verify that there is no cross traffic
After coming to a complete stop and verifying that it is safe to proceed
After you have stopped at least 20 feet prior to the intersection
After slowing down to a speed of 10 mph

questions.correctAnswerText: After coming to a complete stop and verifying that it is safe to proceed
questions.explanation: Stop completely before entering the intersection. Then proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: As the percentage of alcohol (BAC) in your blood increases, you become:

options.text: More intoxicated.
More sober.
More coordinated.

questions.correctAnswerText: More intoxicated.
questions.explanation: Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) measures alcohol in your blood. The higher the BAC, the more impaired you are.

questions.question: "No zones" are areas around trucks where cars:

options.text: Disappear into blind spots or are so close that they restrict the truck driver's ability to stop and maneuver safely.
Have sufficient space to travel behind the truck.
Have several car lengths between their vehicle and the truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: Disappear into blind spots or are so close that they restrict the truck driver's ability to stop and maneuver safely.
questions.explanation: "No zones" are blind spots where cars disappear from view or are so close that the truck driver cannot stop or turn safely. Being in a "No zone" greatly increases crash risk.

questions.question: You are waiting to turn left at a multilane intersection and opposing traffic is blocking your view. You should:

options.text: Accelerate rapidly when the first lane you need to cross is clear.
Wait until you can see all the lanes you need to cross before going ahead with your turn.
Wait for an oncoming driver to wave you across the intersection.
Edge your car into each lane of opposing traffic as soon as it clears.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can see all the lanes you need to cross before going ahead with your turn.
questions.explanation: Never start a left turn until you can see all the lanes you need to cross are clear and safe.

questions.question: You must stop for a school bus:

options.text: That is parked on the shoulder of the road with no one in it.
When it approaches you, even if its lights are not flashing.
If you are both driving on a two-lane highway and its red lights are flashing.
Whenever the driver waves at you.

questions.correctAnswerText: If you are both driving on a two-lane highway and its red lights are flashing.
questions.explanation: Stop when you see a school bus with flashing red lights picking up or dropping off children. On a two-lane road, traffic from both directions must stop while the lights flash.

questions.question: What should you do when you reach a broken traffic light?

options.text: Stop completely and let others go first before you enter.
If the intersection looks clear, you do not need to stop.
Drive fast through the intersection to get out of the way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and let others go first before you enter.
questions.explanation: When a traffic light is broken, treat the intersection like an all-way stop. You must stop completely. Then look both ways and let others go first before entering.

questions.question: If you see a large puddle on the road, you should:

options.text: Keep your speed and drive through it.
Go around it if you can.
Shift to neutral while driving through it.

questions.correctAnswerText: Go around it if you can.
questions.explanation: Avoid slippery areas like puddles, ice, wet leaves, and oil. These can make your car skid. The safest road is dry and solid.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down; a curve is ahead.
Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead becomes slippery when it rains.

questions.question: When can you block an intersection?

options.text: If you entered on a green light.
During busy traffic times.
Never.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never.
questions.explanation: Do not enter an intersection unless you can drive all the way across before the light turns red. If you block the intersection, you can get a ticket.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Directions for children
School zone ahead
Playground area ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone ahead
questions.explanation: This five-sided sign means you are in or near a school zone. Watch for children and obey the posted speed limits.
